issues.description: Wrong page shown: the URL /dashboard is showing the authenticated dashboard instead of the marketing landing page. The expected screen is the marketing landing page with hero image, gold CTA button, and marketing copy.
issues.root_cause: The current URL is /dashboard which correctly renders the dashboard. The landing page should be at / (root route). Either the router is redirecting authenticated users to /dashboard when the test expects the landing page at /, or the landing page route is missing/broken.

issues.description: Hydration error in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx - style prop mismatch: server renders 'width:5%' but client renders 'width:15%'. This causes full root client-side re-render and multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors.
issues.element: Progress bar div in step-3 page
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, a div has an inline style with width calculated dynamically (likely based on step number or state). The server-side value differs from client-side value, indicating a non-deterministic calculation or state that differs between SSR and hydration.

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' appearing 7 times, causing full root switch to client rendering. These appear across multiple pages.
issues.root_cause: Dynamic content (dates, times, or browser-only values) rendered during SSR differs from client hydration. The 'Good evening, Amelia.' greeting uses time-based text that could differ between server and client render.

fixes.reason: The progress bar width differs between SSR and client. Adding suppressHydrationWarning prevents the hydration mismatch error from crashing the entire app while the root cause is investigated.
